data.name: Nahwah
data.gender_notes: Nahwah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nahwah in Arabic refers to a soft breeze or a gentle wind. It's a unisex name and has a spiritual connotation in Islamic tradition. The name Nahwah carries the meaning “The soft breeze” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Nahwah usually hope their child will grow to embody the soft breeze and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Representing the soft breeze, Nahwah symbolizes the soothing presence of Allah, a constant reminder of His gentle guidance and protection.
data.etymology: Nahwah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The soft breeze.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nahwah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: نَهْوَة
in_arabic.long_meaning: بُنيت من الجذر العربي "هَوَى" بمعنى "الجمال" و"الأنوثة"، و "نَحو" بمعنى "المظهر الرائع"، وتُعَدّ نَحْوَة اسمًا أنثويًّا جميلاً يُعبّر عن سُحْرَة المرأة وجمالها الروحي.

in_urdu.name: ناحوا
in_urdu.long_meaning: ناحوا عربی اصل کا نام ہے جس کا معنی 'خوبصورتی' اور 'ہُسن' ہے۔ یہ نام انیس میں خوبروئی اور نرم دل کی تصویر پیش کرتا ہے۔ اسلامی تاریخ میں یہ نام کبھی بھی مذکور نہیں ہوا ہے لیکن اس کے خوبصورت معنی اسے ایک پسندیدہ بچے کا نام بناتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: नहवा
in_hindi.long_meaning: नहवा एक सुंदर नाम है जो मूलतः अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ 'सुंदरता' और 'आकर्षण' होता है। यह नाम महिलाओं की सुंदरता और आकर्षक व्यक्तित्व को दर्शाता है। भारत में इस नाम का उपयोग अधिकतर मुस्लिम समुदाय में किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: نهوا
in_pashto.long_meaning: نهوا په پشتو ژبه کې یوه زېرې نوم دی چې معنا یې "صفای، جمال، زینت" ده. دا نوم لکه د ښځو لوړ جمال او زېرې د لوی ژوند په سمندره کې له دې کلی په سره د دې نوم د پوهاند په توګه درلودلوی.

While not directly mentioned in the Quran, the name holds significant spiritual connotations in Islamic tradition, symbolizing the inner and outer beauty that Allah bestows upon his creation.

In Islamic tradition, the name is also associated with the concept of Allah's infinite mercy and compassion, which is often compared to the gentle and soothing effect of a soft breeze.

Moreover, Nahwah can also be seen as a reminder of the gentle touch of Allah's love and care in our lives. Ultimately, the name Nahwah offers a peaceful and calming reminder of the infinite mercy and compassion of Allah.
